comparability_summary.dataset_and_option_order: identical: same dataset file and sha256, same selected_item_ids
comparability_summary.sender_and_receiver_phase1_trajectories: identical: v4_verify/prebeliefs is a symlink to the V3 artifact, unmodified
comparability_summary.sender_message_content: identical: v4_verify/messages is a symlink to the V3 artifact; per-record payload metadata matches for every condition once the wall-clock field communication_seconds is excluded
comparability_summary.message_injection_position: identical: V4 reuses icr.prompts_v3.external_block() and the same five-block order
comparability_summary.generation_and_scoring: identical: same model, temperature 0.6, top_p 0.95, max_new_tokens 16384, same parser and scorer
comparability_summary.revision_seed: identical record by record: MedQA 232/232 in all four conditions, GPQA-D 228/228 in all three conditions. The V3/V4 comparison IS revision-seed controlled on both datasets.
comparability_summary.what_differs: the receiver integration block only (see receiver_policy_prompts.md)

statebridge_payload_question.question: did the receiver prompt change cause the payload or alignment to be recomputed?
evidence: runs/medqa/v4_verify/messages is a symlink to artifacts/icr_v3/medqa_full_seed42/messages, so prefixes are read, not rebuilt

per-record communication_payload for true_statebridge is byte-identical across V3 and V4 in 232/232 records: {dtype bfloat16, hidden_dimension 2560, modality statebridge, payload_bytes 327680, states 64}

for true_latentmas every substantive field matches (source_generation_seed, source_prompt_sha256, cache_positions, kv_payload_bytes, generated_latent_steps); only communication_seconds, a wall-clock measurement, differs
statebridge_payload_question.conclusion: the claim 'only the receiver instruction changed' is supported for StateBridge and LatentMAS message content
